title: Extract runtime-config domain DTO layer
description: Create a dedicated Python runtime-config module that resolves runtime-root listener/provider config paths, shapes the safe editable DTO for translate/display/TTS fields, and emits masked secret metadata instead of raw secret values.
acceptance_criteria: `GET /api/config` returns a complete editable DTO for supported fields; secret-backed settings expose only configured/source/envKey metadata; runtime-root config path resolution stays correct.
review_initial_requirements: Verify the DTO covers supported translate/display/TTS fields, provider config path resolution is explicit, and secret metadata never returns raw values.
review_regression_requirements: Verify startup config loading rules still come from the existing Python schema owner and runtime root lookup still targets the effective config files.
notes: validated: python -m unittest tests.test_runtime_config_store tests.test_runtime_config tests.test_runtime_shared_helpers

title: Implement validated config-save persistence across listener and provider files
description: Add save-time validation and persistence that preserves unknown fields, keeps listener.json and provider-private TTS JSON separate, writes JSON atomically with LF, and supports write-only direct secret or *_env updates.
acceptance_criteria: Valid saves update listener.json and provider-private files at their existing boundaries; windows_system/doubao/tencent_cloud remain supported; invalid payloads leave existing files unchanged and return field-level errors.
review_initial_requirements: Verify unknown fields survive round-trip writes, provider-private fields never leak back into listener.json, and write-only secret updates do not echo raw values in responses.
review_regression_requirements: Verify existing config helpers still produce LF JSON, atomic replace semantics stay intact, and startup validation parity is preserved.
notes: depends: DCFG-01-01; validated: python -m unittest tests.test_runtime_config_store tests.test_runtime_config tests.test_runtime_shared_helpers

title: Expose full config read/save endpoints and apply strategy metadata
description: Wire the new runtime-config layer into BackendRuntimeService and runtime_api.py so GET returns the safe DTO, save requests return validation errors or success, and responses include whether apply is managed or manual without changing existing runtime/session endpoint semantics.
acceptance_criteria: The backend serves full config GET and save endpoints, returns field-level validation errors on bad input, and reports whether the caller can only save or can save-and-apply.
review_initial_requirements: Verify HTTP methods, response shapes, and error status codes are explicit; confirm existing /healthz, /api/runtime, /api/sessions, and /events behaviour stays untouched.
review_regression_requirements: Verify runtime tts-auto-read remains a runtime-only action and config save responses do not imply hot reload before restart.
notes: depends: DCFG-01-01, DCFG-01-02; validated: python -m unittest tests.test_backend_runtime tests.test_runtime_api

title: Hydrate settings state in the desktop shell hook
description: Extend the desktop-shell API client and shell state hook to load the config DTO, maintain dirty/save/error/apply availability state, and keep persisted tts_auto_read_active_chat separate from the runtime header toggle state.
acceptance_criteria: The shell can open settings and hydrate config data; dirty/save/error state is tracked; editing persisted defaults does not mutate the runtime header toggle.
review_initial_requirements: Verify hook state separates persisted config from runtime-only actions, and config hydrate/save failures surface stable UI state instead of collapsing the existing shell connection model.
review_regression_requirements: Verify snapshot/bootstrap, WebSocket live sync, and runtime toggle handling continue to work when the settings state is mounted.
notes: depends: DCFG-01-03; validated: cd desktop-shell && npm test && npm run build

title: Add the desktop-shell settings workspace and provider-specific forms
description: Add a settings entry and settings workspace that edits supported translate/display fields and renders form branches for windows_system, doubao, and tencent_cloud without breaking the existing runtime overview, session navigation, and message-reading shell layout.
acceptance_criteria: The shell exposes a settings entry, loads the config DTO, shows save-only feedback when apply is unavailable, and renders a complete form branch for each supported TTS provider.
review_initial_requirements: Verify each supported TTS provider has a usable form branch, secret inputs are write-only, and the settings workspace does not displace the shell main information hierarchy.
review_regression_requirements: Verify the existing header runtime actions still work and no unsupported provider can be selected without a matching form.
notes: depends: DCFG-02-01; validated: cd desktop-shell && npm test && npm run build

title: Add frontend regression coverage for settings hydration and CTA branches
description: Add frontend tests that lock settings hydration, dirty state, provider-specific rendering, save success/failure feedback, and save-only versus managed-apply CTA behaviour.
acceptance_criteria: Frontend tests cover settings hydrate, provider branching, save success/failure, and CTA branching for managed versus save-only connections.
review_initial_requirements: Verify tests target the derived state and view branches that are most likely to regress instead of only snapshotting markup.
review_regression_requirements: Verify existing shell state tests still pass and new settings tests do not depend on unstable network timing.
notes: depends: DCFG-02-01, DCFG-02-02; validated: cd desktop-shell && npm test && npm run build; focus: use-desktop-settings/settings-workspace branches

title: Add Tauri ownership reporting and owned-backend restart command
description: Expose Tauri-side backend ownership information and add a managed restart command that only restarts the backend sidecar owned by the current shell instance, with regression coverage for owned versus unowned flows.
acceptance_criteria: The shell can determine whether the backend is owned, owned sidecars can be restarted, and reused/external backends are rejected instead of being killed.
review_initial_requirements: Verify restart permission is based on shell-owned markers instead of guesswork, and command failures do not leave stale ownership state behind.
review_regression_requirements: Verify bootstrap, single-instance behaviour, health waiting, and existing connection info commands still behave the same.
notes: depends: DCFG-01-03; validated: cd desktop-shell/src-tauri && cargo test; focus: owned restart gate + connection info ownership flags

title: Wire save-and-apply through managed restart and reconnect
description: Connect the frontend settings flow to the Tauri managed restart command so save-and-apply first persists config, then restarts only the owned backend sidecar, waits for health recovery, and restores shell connectivity without closing the window.
acceptance_criteria: Save-and-apply is available only on owned managed connections; successful apply reconnects to the backend; failed saves or unowned connections never trigger restart.
test_mcp: cd desktop-shell && npm test && cd src-tauri && cargo test
review_initial_requirements: Verify the frontend does not invoke restart before save success, reconnect state stays explicit, and apply-only UI never appears for unowned or dev connections.
review_regression_requirements: Verify save-only flow still works in unmanaged mode and the shell recovers from backend restart using the existing health/bootstrap contract.

title: Update operator docs for config DTO and save/apply semantics
description: Update listener config and pitfalls documentation so the repo documents the GUI settings path, secret masking rules, listener/provider file boundaries, and the difference between save-only and managed apply.
acceptance_criteria: config/listener.md and docs/wechat-listening-pitfalls.md describe the editable fields, secret handling, file boundaries, and save/apply behaviour without contradicting the shipped runtime.
review_initial_requirements: Verify the docs reflect actual field names, provider boundaries, and managed apply limits instead of aspirational behaviour.
review_regression_requirements: Verify the docs still preserve the existing runtime contract around no hot reload, external backend safety, and provider-private config separation.

title: Run end-to-end regression and record any limited validation
description: Run the planned Python, frontend, Rust, build, and manual managed/unmanaged verification for the full settings flow, and record any environment-limited checks or manual follow-up steps in the issue notes if complete automation is not possible.
acceptance_criteria: Python, npm, cargo, build, and manual save/save-and-apply checks are executed or explicitly marked as validation_limited with manual_test steps and risk level.
test_mcp: python -m pytest && cd desktop-shell && npm test && npm run build && cd src-tauri && cargo test
review_initial_requirements: Verify the executed checks actually cover backend contract, frontend settings, managed restart ownership, and documentation-driven operator flow.
review_regression_requirements: Verify any skipped checks are documented with validation_limited, manual_test, and risk entries instead of being silently omitted.
